title: Minimum Time to Finish All Jobs

monster.name: Workload Arbiter
monster.title: Equalizer of Labor Shifts
monster.defeatQuote: Distribute all burdens across k workers to minimize the maximum load!

description: You are given an integer array `jobs`, where `jobs[i]` is the amount of time it takes to complete the `i-th` job, and an integer `k`. There are `k` workers. Every job should be assigned to exactly one worker. A worker's working time is the sum of times of all jobs assigned to that worker. Return the minimum possible maximum working time of any assignment.
starterCode:
def minimumTimeRequired(jobs: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minimumTimeRequired(jobs: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    jobs.sort(reverse=True)
    workers = [0] * k
    best = sum(jobs)
    def backtrack(idx):
        nonlocal best
        if idx == len(jobs):
            best = min(best, max(workers))
            return
        seen = set()
        for w in range(k):
            if workers[w] in seen or workers[w] + jobs[idx] >= best:
                continue
            seen.add(workers[w])
            workers[w] += jobs[idx]
            backtrack(idx + 1)
            workers[w] -= jobs[idx]
            if workers[w] == 0: break
    backtrack(0)
    return best
hints: Sort jobs descending. Backtrack across workers with symmetry breaking (skip empty workers if one already failed, and prune by current best).
